name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 26 - Am 83
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 26 a. Stresses that the persistent housing crisis represents a growing risk for the economic and social cohesion of the Union; insists on the need for social investments financed through the EU budget to ensure a right to decent, affordable and accessible housing for all, particularly for the youth and the most vulnerable;
